seoTitle: How to Remove Page Numbers in Google Docs (2026)
metaDescription: Delete or hide page numbers in Google Docs globally, or just on your cover page, using header settings and Different first page controls.
intro: Whether you need to strip page numbers entirely or just hide them on a title page, Google Docs gives you a few different controls to handle it. This guide covers deleting the automated number token directly, using the Different first page toggle for cover sheets, and using section breaks to isolate numbering in multi-part documents.

steps.heading: Open your header or footer
steps.body: Click into the header or footer area of your document where the page numbering currently lives.

steps.heading: Delete the number globally
steps.body: Select and delete the automated page number token to remove counting tags across your entire document at once.

steps.heading: Or open Page Numbers settings
steps.body: Go to Insert, then Page numbers, to access the advanced configuration dashboard for more targeted control.

steps.heading: Hide numbers on the cover page only
steps.body: Enable Different first page to mask numbering specifically on your title or cover sheet while keeping it on later pages.

steps.heading: Restart numbering with section breaks
steps.body: Use Section Breaks from the Layout menu to isolate specific page blocks and restart or remove numbering in just that section.

steps.heading: Check the layout on mobile
steps.body: Review your changes in the Google Docs mobile app on Android or iOS to confirm number visibility before printing.

faq.question: How do I remove page numbers from just my title page?
faq.answer: Enable the Different first page option in your header and footer settings so the numbering starts appearing only from the second page onward.

faq.question: Can I remove page numbers completely from a document?
faq.answer: Yes, deleting the automated number token in the header or footer area clears numbering globally across all pages.

faq.question: Will removing page numbers affect my page count?
faq.answer: No, the total number of pages stays the same; only the visible counting labels are removed.

faq.question: How do I restart numbering partway through a document?
faq.answer: Insert a Section Break at the point where you want numbering to restart, then configure separate numbering settings for that new section.
